body: <script>window.addEventListener('load', () => customElements.whenDefined('sf-editor-overlay').then(() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.setDocument({schema: 'simai.composition.document.v1', id: 'd', profile: 'ui-layout', root: {id: 'root', type: 'layout.section', slots: {default: [{id: 'h', type: 'content.heading'}, {id: 'p', type: 'content.paragraph'}]}}}, {describe: (node) => ({label: node.id})}); o.actions = [{id: 'remove', label: 'Удалить'}]; }));</script>

checks.title: the structure tree is named by the language file; the settings are properties; actions are checked as setActions checks them
checks.covers: accessibility role tree, lang runtime.tree, settings.for, settings.actions

steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const tree = o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree'); let refused = false; try { o.actions = [{id: 'Bad id', label: 'x'}]; } catch (error) { refused = error instanceof TypeError; } return tree.getAttribute('role') === 'tree' && tree.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Структура страницы' && o.for === 'canvas' && o.accepts === 'blocks' && refused && o.actions.length === 1 && o.actions[0].id === 'remove'; })()

checks.title: selecting a node sends sf-composition-overlay-select {ids, id} with node_id kept
a toolbar action sends sf-composition-overlay-apply {action, scope: entry, ids}, then the dated -action {action_id, node_id}
an insertion point sends sf-composition-overlay-insert {parent, slot, index} with parent_id kept
an action with an icon is an icon button named by its label; an unavailable one stays where it is, dimmed; an action of id and label stays a text button

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.select('h'); o.actions = [{id: 'up', label: 'Выше', icon: 'arrow_upward', shortcut: '⌥↑', disabled: true}, {id: 'remove', label: 'Удалить', icon: 'delete', tone: 'danger'}, {id: 'plain', label: 'Текст'}]; return true; })()
steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const up = o.querySelector('button[data-action=up]'); const remove = o.querySelector('button[data-action=remove]'); const plain = o.querySelector('button.sf-composition-overlay-action[data-action=plain]'); let refused = false; try { o.actions = [{id: 'x', label: 'x', tone: 'loud'}]; } catch (error) { refused = error instanceof TypeError; } return up.disabled && up.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Выше' && remove.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Удалить' && !remove.disabled && plain.textContent === 'Текст' && refused; })()

checks.title: placement is a setting: top by default, side on request, anything else reads as the default

steps.check: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); const first = o.placement; o.placement = 'side'; const second = o.getAttribute('placement'); o.removeAttribute('placement'); return first === 'top' && second === 'side' && o.placement === 'top'; })()

checks.title: a key the host mapped to an action sends apply for the selected node

steps.script: (() => { const o = document.getElementById('o'); o.actions = [{id: 'down', label: 'Ниже', shortcut: '⌥↓'}]; o.select('h'); o.querySelector('.sf-composition-overlay-tree').focus(); return true; })()
